responseMessageContents.text:
I see you are in the Render dashboard. That is not where we need to fix AWS. The AWS policy is still missing.

I will be direct. The problem is in the **AWS Console**, not Render. I cannot do it from the sandbox because the AWS key lacks IAM permissions.

You were already on the AWS screen. The exact step is:

1. In the AWS mobile console, go to **IAM → Users → ivx-sns-production**
2. Tap **"Add permissions"**
3. Choose **"Create inline policy"**
4. Tap **JSON**
5. Paste this:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "IVXS3Landing",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:PutObjectAcl",
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:DeleteObject",
        "s3:ListBucket",
        "s3:HeadBucket"
      ],
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:s3:::ivxholding.com",
        "arn:aws:s3:::ivxholding.com/*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IVXCloudFront",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "cloudfront:CreateInvalidation",
        "cloudfront:GetInvalidation",
        "cloudfront:ListInvalidations"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:cloudfront::138045599684:distribution/E1C0DEI0VKCUYN"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IVXSNS",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "sns:Publish",
        "sns:GetSMSAttributes",
        "sns:SetSMSAttributes"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

6. Name it **IVXPlatformDeployAccess**
7. Save

Once you confirm that is done, I will deploy the landing page and run the full QA. I will not ask you to do anything else in the console.
